tools.description: Hosted large-language-model coding agent, run from a local terminal and from cloud sessions, that writes code, tests and design records under the repository's agent instruction file; every change reaches main only through a reviewed pull request and CI.

Hosted large-language-model coding agent from a second vendor that reviews pull requests and design records, and builds assigned slices; its findings and changes go through the same pull request review and CI as any other.
Local, open-source code knowledge-graph tool that parses source files into a graph for navigation; run in code-only mode, which is local syntax-tree parsing with no model call, and never on prose.
Local plugin for the coding agent that shortens its own replies to save tokens; no network calls and no repository writes.
